issue: Recovery code validation accepts any matching code and never consumes a code after successful authentication, allowing codes to be reused indefinitely and the requested code number will never advance

Recovery codes are serialized and sent as raw/plaintext to user-storage via updateCredential, which is inconsistent with the built-in local credential (hashed secretData) and increases exposure if the user store is compromised
Javadoc grammar error: 'a optional' should be 'an optional' (also remove the extra space)
